references.text: Contrast verse showing the curse for disobedience - 'Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out' - the opposite of the blessing in verse 6.
The Lord will keep your going out and your coming in from now on and forevermore - same theme of God's protection over all movements of life.
The Aaronic blessing which also promises the Lord's blessing and protection over the people.
Solomon's prayer that the Lord may bless both when one goes out and comes in - same wording and concept.
Peter speaks of men who were with the disciples the whole time Jesus went in and out among them - showing how this expression describes one's entire way of life.
Jesus says 'the one who enters through me will be saved, and he will go in and go out and find pasture' - blessing over all movement for the believer.
